title: Terahertz Communications and Sensing for 6G and Beyond: A Comprehensive Review
affiliation: 15+ institutions including Budapest University of Technology, RPTU Kaiserslautern, University of Oulu, CentraleSupelec, Shenzhen University
domain: THz Communications / THz Sensing / 6G / ISAC / Beamforming / Channel Modeling
paper_type: Comprehensive Technology Survey with System Design Focus

analysis_policy.focus: Extract holistic system design patterns, multi-aspect coverage strategy, and comparison table architectures
analysis_policy.depth: Full paper analysis including 10 main sections, 400+ references, extensive comparison tables

section_flow.title: Introduction
subsections: Why Do 6G and Beyond Need the THz Band?
section_flow.summary: Answers fundamental question 'Why THz for 6G?' from three perspectives: THz Communications (spectrum scarcity), THz Sensing (high resolution, penetration), and Synergy (ISAC benefits). Lists 10+ major contributions.
key_claims: THz band offers 10x more bandwidth than mmWave
THz enables unique sensing, imaging, and positioning capabilities
Synergy between THz communications and sensing provides significant ISAC benefits

section_flow.title: Overview of THz-Based 6G Systems
section_flow.summary: Comprehensive global 6G development overview (EU Hexa-X, US Next G Alliance, China IMT-2030, Japan B5GPC, Korea K-Network 2030, Germany 6G Platform). Spectrum assignment history and IEEE 802.15.3d standardization.
key_claims: 160 GHz spectrum available for THz without EESS protection requirements
IEEE 802.15.3d-2017 specifies PHY for 252-325 GHz with >100 Gbps
Multiple countries have 6G initiatives targeting 2030

section_flow.title: Potential THz Applications in 6G and Beyond
section_flow.summary: Enumerates 7 communication applications (Hotspots, Campus/Private, D2D, V2X, Secure, Backhaul, Nano-Networks) and 3 sensing applications (Sensing, Imaging, Positioning). Maps to IMT-2030 scenarios.
key_claims: THz enables Tbps links for holographic communications
THz sensing provides centimeter-level localization
Non-ionizing nature enables safe biomedical applications

section_flow.title: THz Propagation and Channel Characterization
section_flow.summary: Comprehensive propagation characterization with Friis equation derivation, ITU-R P676 atmospheric model, weather effects (rain, fog, snow, dust), and blockage statistics.
key_claims: FSPL increases 20 dB per decade of frequency
Water vapor absorption peaks at 17.1 dB/m at 560 GHz
Rain attenuation 10-20 dB/km at THz band

section_flow.title: THz Channel Measurement and Modeling for 6G and Beyond
section_flow.summary: Three measurement techniques (VNA, Sliding Correlation, TDS) and three modeling approaches (Deterministic/Ray-tracing, Statistical/S-V model, Hybrid).
key_claims: VNA provides high precision narrowband measurement
Ray tracing suitable for static 6G applications
Hybrid models combine ray-tracing with stochastics

section_flow.title: THz Transceiver: Antenna and Devices
section_flow.summary: Antenna types (horn, planar, substrate-integrated, lens, graphene) and device technologies (electronic vs photonic approach, graphene-based components).
key_claims: Graphene antennas enable nano-scale THz communications
Lens antenna arrays compensate for high path loss
Photonic devices overcome THz gap limitations

section_flow.title: Beamforming and Alignment for THz Communications and Sensing
section_flow.summary: UMMIMO architectures, lens antenna array designs, beam training methods, beam estimation algorithms for THz.
key_claims: UMMIMO with 1024+ antennas compensates for path loss
Lens arrays provide spatial focusing
Fast beam alignment critical for mobile THz

section_flow.title: THz Systems and Networks Toward 6G and Beyond
section_flow.summary: 10 subsections covering synergy with other 6G technologies: MMIMO, NOMA, RIS, NTN, Digital Twins, AI/ML. Security and localization aspects.
key_claims: RIS can overcome THz blockage through intelligent reflection
AI/ML enables adaptive THz beamforming
THz provides inherent physical layer security

section_flow.title: Integrated THz Communications and Sensing
section_flow.summary: Deep dive into THz-based ISAC: use cases, waveforms (OFDM, FMCW), algorithms, RIS integration, and challenges with solutions.
key_claims: THz enables sensing-aided communication
Joint waveform design critical for ISAC
RIS can boost both communications and sensing

section_flow.title: THz Trials and Experiments
section_flow.summary: Overview of practical THz trials and experiments by industry (NTT, Ericsson, Nokia) and academia, with achieved data rates table.
key_claims: 100+ Gbps demonstrated over short distances
300 GHz band most commonly used for trials
Commercial THz deployment expected post-2030

rhetorical_contract.promise: Provide comprehensive treatment and technology survey on THz communications and sensing for 6G and beyond
rhetorical_contract.delivery_mechanism: Why THz → Applications → Propagation → Measurement/Modeling → Hardware → Beamforming → Networks → ISAC → Trials
rhetorical_contract.unique_contribution: First survey combining both THz communications AND THz sensing with ISAC focus, covering full technology stack from propagation to system design

comparison_tables.purpose: Compare this survey with existing works across 9 content coverage dimensions
Evolution of cellular systems (1G-5G) - frequency, bandwidth, data rate

Map THz applications to IMT-2030 usage scenarios
Research works summary on propagation characteristics

figure_types.example: Fig. 2 - EM spectrum with mmWave, THz, optical positions

synthesis.integration_approach: Full technology stack coverage from physics to system design
synthesis.key_paradigm: THz as dual-functional enabler for hyper-rate communications and high-resolution sensing (ISAC)
gap_identification: Channel models for 1-10 THz need calibration

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Open the survey by explicitly stating and answering a fundamental question that justifies the survey's focus area
structure: State the question in italics or bold: 'Why do we need to exploit the THz band in 6G and beyond?'
Answer from multiple perspectives (2-3 named subsections)
Each perspective presents distinct advantages with bullet points
Conclude with synergy between perspectives
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Section I-A 'Why Do 6G and Beyond Need the THz Band?' with 3 subsections: THz Communications, THz Sensing, Synergy
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Establishes clear rationale; pre-empts reader questions; demonstrates balanced perspective

reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Fig. 3 showing 10 sections with summaries and subsection lists
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Aids navigation; provides roadmap; helps readers find relevant content quickly

key_concepts.thz_gap: Frequency region too high for electronics, too low for photonics
key_concepts.isac: Integrated Sensing and Communications for dual-functional systems
